skills.label: Strike
skills.description: A focused physical attack against a target in the room.

skills.label: Intercept
skills.description: Steps in front of incoming attacks aimed at a vulnerable ally, absorbing the blow.

skills.label: Hold
skills.description: Holds defensive stance when critically wounded, avoiding risky exposure.

skills.label: Heal
skills.description: Unseals soothing draughts for any wounded ally, restoring health.

skills.label: Trace
skills.description: Inscribes glowing tactical chalk sigils upon the stone.

skills.label: Teleport
skills.description: Instantly transports the party back to the armed teleportation anchor.
